short.use_when: One sharp idea, announcement, reaction, question, or compact call to action.

standard.use_when: A complete argument, practical framework, comparison, or compact story.

long.use_when: Deep analysis, guide, case study, narrative, breakdown, or multi-step system.

auto_rules: Choose long when the subject needs evidence, a sequence of steps, a story, or a real breakdown.
Choose standard for one developed argument with examples and a useful conclusion.
Choose short only when compression strengthens the idea; never shorten merely to satisfy a campaign template.
Treat the ranges as editorial guidance, not quotas. Telegram's 4096 UTF-16 limit is the only hard text limit.

quality_rules: Match the selected channel profile before optimizing hooks or style.
Use a confirmed channel description when available; otherwise label and use the inferred description.
Do not cross-post the same text. Adapt the angle, examples, vocabulary, and depth to each channel.
Check factual, medical, financial, and performance claims against available sources; do not invent precise numbers.
Keep natural Russian and Telegram-compatible formatting. A headline is optional, not mandatory.
Review quality, thematic fit, clarity, and originality independently from post length.
